title: Flatworld Dimension
body:
Adds a simple flatworld dimension.


```
World settings:
  Y Level | Block
  
      -64 | Bedrock
-63 to -1 | Dirt
        0 | Grass block
```


Meant for admin use-create the portal and get the igniter in creative mode.
Works great with essentials for setting warps/homes.

Portal is made with bedrock and lit with a "Flatworld Portal Activator".

This was created for personal use but I'm sharing in case others need the same functionality for their forge server.
